Title: D8: Add llama.cpp as Parallel Inference Backend
Content: Decision D8 (2026-06-01): Add llama.cpp server as a parallel inference backend alongside Ollama on Node B. NodeClient.LlamaCpp targets the OAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Backend selected by NODE_B_BACKEND env var (default: ollama, set llamacpp to switch). Key advantages over Ollama: exposes --n-cpu-moe (MoE expert offloading) enabling 30B MoE models on 8 GB VRAM, true SSE streaming, TurboQuant KV cache compression. Decision on permanent replacement vs. coexistence deferred until benchmarking on actual GTX 1080 hardware confirms throughput/quality.
